locations.note: Jonathan Hunt comes to Debrecen for a long weekend and ends up chasing a missing boy and a meteorite with a secret, the kind that fell at Kaba in 1857; the trail runs through the downtown streets and squares, all filmed on location.
Jonathan's friend Vera works at the nuclear research institute, where he gets a water sample analysed and pokes around its laboratories.
The old solar observatory in the botanical garden, with the benches by the turtles' pond outside, is one of the places the meteorite trail leads.
Jonathan searches the Great Library of the Reformed College for the professor's papers.
